events.name: Achieved Quota
events.source:
if SUM([Achievement (copy)]) >= [Parameters].[New Quota] then "100% +"
elseif SUM([Achievement (copy)]) >= 0.75 * [Parameters].[New Quota] then "75-100%"
elseif SUM([Achievement (copy)]) >= 0.5 * [Parameters].[New Quota] then "50-75%"
else "Below 50%" end
events.result: SWITCH(TRUE(), SUM('Sales Commission'[Achievement (estimated)]) >= [New Quota Value], "100% +", SUM('Sales Commission'[Achievement (estimated)]) >= 0.75 * [New Quota Value], "75-100%", SUM('Sales Commission'[Achievement (estimated)]) >= 0.5 * [New Quota Value], "50-75%", "Below 50%")

events.name: Days to Ship Scheduled
events.source:
CASE  [Ship Mode]
WHEN "Same Day" THEN 0
WHEN "First Class" THEN 1
WHEN "Second Class" THEN 3
WHEN "Standard Class" THEN 6
END
events.result: SWITCH('Orders'[Ship Mode], "Same Day", 0, "First Class", 1, "Second Class", 3, "Standard Class", 6)
